question.text: The Financial Performance of the portfolio manager in the Disclosure Document is based on:

answer.text: Audited financial statements and SEBI-specified procedure

explanation.text: The Logic: The Financial Performance row in the Disclosure Document is based on audited financial statements following the SEBI-specified procedure. The Trap: Composite performance can be confused with the separate Performance of Portfolio Manager row, which is based on last-three-year performance and TWRR. Note: Distinguish Financial Performance (audited) from Performance of Portfolio Manager (TWRR / last three years).
